name: Epischura copepod
desc: An endemic copepod that makes up most of the zooplankton biomass and filters the open water. Golomyanka and seals eat it.
about: Epischurella baikalensis is a species of copepod in family Temoridae. It is endemic to Lake Baikal, being the dominant zooplankton species there: 80%–90% of total biomass.
